item.title: GovBrief Today #624
item.description: Today Donald Trump told the people counting California's midterm ballots that they "will all go to jail for a long period of time." Nobody has charged them with a crime. Yesterday his Justice Department asked a federal judge to stop the state from counting more than 20,000 mail ballots from voters it calls likely noncitizens. Then it warned election officials they could be prosecuted as accomplices if they count them anyway. Trump shared the letter and skipped straight to their punishment. The warning went to Los Angeles County, the state's largest, which received the government's list on a password-protected thumb drive. Any charges there would come from the federal prosecutor's office in Los Angeles, the same office that filed the day-old lawsuit no judge has ruled on yet. I've emailed 9,560 stories over 624 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. item.title: It had to be done
item.description: Just going to edit in a quick and absolutely not comprehensive description. I and my now ex GF are both middle aged, divorcees, etc. We have been dating for almost five months. When we met she seemed maybe not quite as hard left as I am but still on the good side of history. We were getting ready to go do something today and her recently 18 year old son was on some kind of voice chat or whatever in his room with his door open. Screaming and yelling about whatever. GF was getting something out of her adjacent room, also door open. Kid starts in about how he isn't a racist, but then says that he is only a racist to --ws and ---lims, and if whoever he was talking to didn't like it, then he was a HARD R n - word. She had to have heard this too. So I get my shit and leave. She comes out after me and I'm like, do you really tolerate this? And her response wasn't so great. So I left. Texted her that I would mail her the few things that she has at my place. I really liked her. But there were some yellow flags in the relationship that had only started to come out as we were getting closer to six months. I could try to ignore some yellow flags, but this was a hard red flag that I can not ignore or tolerate.
